newsitem.title: USA: Dow Industrials higher in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Dow Industrials higher in early trade.

text.p: U.S. stocks moved higher in early trading on Tuesday, spurred on by a rally in the bond market due to a smaller than forecast rise in the U.S. December consumer price index (CPI).
The Dow Jones industrial average was up five at 6,714 and the Nasdaq Composite up seven at 1,338.
The 30-year bond was up 26/32 to yield 6.79 percent.
